free_tier.stated: Quoted: "Firebase Studio is sunsetting on March 22, 2027. As of June 22, 2026, new workspace creation and user signup are disabled." The plan was 3 workspaces per user at no cost.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: Nothing new. The migration targets named by Google, AI Studio and Antigravity, were not evaluated and are the obvious next check for an always-on free development environment from Google.
limits_note: New accounts cannot create a workspace at all since 2026-06-22, so the 3-free-workspace quota is closed; existing workspaces keep running until 2027-03-22.
binding_note: New accounts cannot create a workspace at all since 2026-06-22, so the 3-free-workspace quota is closed; existing workspaces keep running until 2027-03-22.

identity_cost.detail: no signup is possible at all: 'As of June 22, 2026, new workspace creation and user signup are disabled', so there is no requirement left to meet and the 3-workspace quota is closed to new accounts. What the pre-closure signup asked for - email, phone, card or ID - is not described in any evidence row: unknown. No hold is stated.

evidence.proved: sunset on 2027-03-22, new workspace creation and signup disabled from 2026-06-22, and 3 workspaces per user at no cost, quoted
the same notice in the FAQ, plus the statement that the no-cost plan is limited to three workspaces per user
existing workspaces can be worked in until the sunset date and must be migrated to Google AI Studio or Google Antigravity

notes: This is the most commonly recommended free cloud IDE that no longer accepts users, and listicles written before June 2026 still describe three free Nix-based workspaces. Recorded as dead with the two dates, because a reader needs to know both that it is closing and that it is already closed to them. Apps already deployed to Firebase keep running after the sunset, which is a different product.
